instruction: Six workers build a wall in 10 days. Assuming all workers work at the same constant rate, how many days does it take for 4 workers to build the same wall? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
